summary: Much better than V1. The VO pipeline bug is gone: 79 lines, real speakers, 64 distinct durations and no overlaps. Every line-anchored cut now lands on or just before its line: L010 football/piano/math lines up with S013/S014/S015, L056 'turned the wrong way' with S077, L060 'spotted Noah' with S082, and L068 'Eli made the adjustment / turned / missed the barrier' runs across S091/S091b-S092/S093. The big V1 sense breaks are fixed: dawn bedroom for 'one morning', one shared competition clock on the scoreboard and the overlay (FINAL 0:60 down to WINNER 0:01, consistent through S084), Eli present in S051, the sepia S087 flashback that copies the S059 two-shot, real backs of heads in the OTS shots, the matching S026/S108 shock-then-deadpan callback with the title on black, and seated continuity in S106-S108. What still breaks sense is concentrated in the payoff and the emotional hinge. (1) The finish happens twice and the clock runs backwards: S094 shows the robot reaching FINISH at 0:04-0:03, S094b shows 0:01, then S095 opens at 0:02 and the robot crosses the line again at 0:01. (2) The S093 'swerve' avoids nothing: the robot drives in the far lane (y 860) while the barrier sits in the near lane (y 1000), and its 2D rotate() looks like a nose-up hop, not a turn. (3) The S066 'lowers the screwdriver to the bench' still never reads: the bench is drawn at y 1010, under the letterbox, so the tool drops out of frame. (4) The 'shout' and 'panic' mouth is a D-shaped grin, so in the key hall exchange Noah ('I told you that three weeks ago!', 'LEFT SIDE!') and Eli ('NOAH!', 'What do I do?!') look like they are laughing. Smaller but visible problems remain: Eli faces Noah smiling in S065/S067 (he reads as taunting, not oblivious), the robot is missing from the table in S084, the S054b phone flips by itself and then vanishes, the book sits on Eli's head in S020/S044, S091b is an abstract blue rectangle, and the S045 bigger kid runs off and leaves the ball behind.
strengths: VO and picture are in sync. There are no overlapping lines, all six speakers are correct, and character lines start 0.05-0.3 s after their cut. The L042→L043 'change the—' / 'Already fixed it' handoff plays as an interruption.

One shared clock: scoreboard and overlay agree in every arena frame (S084: overlay 0:30 = scoreboard FINAL 0:30). The clock runs at roughly real time (0:58 at 253.5 s, 0:39 at 270.9 s, 0:09 at 298.8 s), keeps running through the S087 flashback, and the scoreboard reads WINNER 0:01 in S096-S102.

Cause and effect in the failure works: S076 POV at the METAL BARRIER, then S077 the robot veers off the dotted route and bumps barrier 3 (red pulse), then S080b it is stuck against the barrier with the orange LED, then S079 diagnostics show 'ERROR SOURCE: ???'. S094 resumes from the same barrier on ROUTE_RECOVER.

The plant is clearer: S059 Noah holds up and points at his own diagram, S060 cuts from the diagram to the robot's lit BACKUP SENSOR · LEFT SIDE box, S063 is a top shot of Noah's diagram being pushed aside, and the S087 sepia flashback reuses the S059 blocking.

Time of day is consistent: S019 6:00 AM → dawn bedroom S020-S029 → sunset music room and field → night bedroom for languages and 2:00 AM (S041-S044) → warm workshop afternoon → cool S069 → arena → dusk S103.

Screen geography in the hall exchange holds: Eli faces and points screen-right toward Noah (S083, S085), Noah points screen-left back (S090), and the S084 wide from behind Eli puts Noah in the bleachers in the right place.
The callback works: S026 and S108 share the same headAt and scale and the same shock→half-lid deadpan timing, and the title now sits on black (S109), not over his face.

Prop and wardrobe continuity: the friends' photo on Eli's bench (S055→S068→S104), the TEAM: ELI & NOAH card (S071), the empty stool, red and blue stripes, the screwdriver on Noah's empty bench (tiny, but present), EXPERIMENT 1/2/3 labels in sequence, and the 6/7 stamp matching 'almost every answer'.

v1_followup.note: 79 lines, speakers NAR/ELI/NOA/TEA/STU/ANN, 64 distinct durations, 0 overlaps. Total 353.1 s.
One finalSecs() clock drives the scoreboard and the overlay. NEW side-effects are listed in issues: S075 renders '0:60', and S094b hard-codes '0:01' before S095 shows 0:02.
Dawn sky and window in every B08-B12 shot. Night kept for S041-S044.
The arm is now raised beside the head and the face is clear, but no headset mic is visible, so he still isn't identifiable as the announcer.

Eli is seated at the desk on the left and the student stands behind it pointing at him. Minor: Eli smiles at the camera instead of looking up at the student, and the cube is already on the desk (no slap).
It no longer passes through the barrier, but the robot is never in the barrier's lane (robot y 860, barrier y 1000), so nothing is avoided. The 2D rotate reads as a hop. See issues.
The screwdriver is hand-sized now, but the bench (y 1010-1050) is hidden under the bottom letterbox. The tool leaves the frame at 2 s and Noah stands empty-handed for 2.6 s. The set-down never reads.

The screwdriver is on Noah's empty bench (very small) and dark door-jamb edges were added. Eli still faces the camera, idle with his arm out, in S067 and S068. He is not working with his back turned, so 'didn't notice' is still contradicted.

S059 (Noah points at his diagram) and S063 (top shot, diagram pushed aside) are fixed. S061 is acceptable. S065 has Eli facing Noah head-on with a smile while saying 'I'll probably finish it faster', which reads as deliberate gloating.
Sepia, the S059 two-shot reused, Noah holding the diagram.
The FG actor is now the back of the head or cap, blurred.
The trophy now stands on a base. The 'official's hand' is a disembodied arm whose hand stops short of the trophy. Eli's lookX flip is barely readable.
The sleeve enters from the bottom-right edge, and a full-size green 6/7 stamp replaces the F.
Insert sleeves now run off-frame (S056, S063, S091). The S002/S003/S032/S035/S105 hands are still flat palms facing the camera with the fingers pointing up, hovering over the keys.
S020: the open book covers Eli's face at head height. S044: the book sits on top of his head (head under it, not on it).
Same framing and the same shock→deadpan face. Title on black.
Walk-in and sit with no hop. S107 and S108 are seated. Minor: Eli's stool is too far from the keys for him to 'play the first bars', and S108's arms-out pose reads as cross-legged meditation.
The rims are visible around the shock eyes, but they don't slide down.
S050 eager grin, S098 worried, S071 neutral. A different expression bug, the shout mouth, is listed in issues.
The grey METAL tag still covers 'CON' in 'METAL CAN CONFUSE IT!' in S060.
He still lands head-down with his legs up in a diagonal and freezes about 1.6 s. The ball rolls only about 100 px.
Guitar on a locker, chess-club flyer, hoops poster. The cube label was dropped.
Side views still put the blue box on the rear end of the robot while the label says LEFT SIDE. Low priority.

issues.problem: The payoff happens twice and the shared clock runs backwards. S094 (overhead) drives the robot all the way onto FINISH at 0:04-0:03 (topRun to k=.95). S094b then shows a hard-coded '0:01'. S095 opens with the overlay at 0:02 and the robot crosses the line again, reaching 0:01. A viewer sees it finish, sees 0:01, then sees 0:02 and a second finish.
issues.fix: act3.js S094: atE(c,0,c.d,'inOut')*.82 so the robot stops about 120 px short of the checkered flag. S094b: PR.timer(..., fmtClock(finalSecs(c.T))) instead of the literal '0:01'. finalSecs(): set s1 = shotStart('S094b') so the clock reads 0:01 from S094b through the S095 crossing (keep the WINNER switch at S095+.45). S095 then crosses at a steady 0:01.

issues.problem: The 'swerve around the barrier' doesn't read. The robot rides in the far lane (y 860→770) the whole time and the barrier sits in the near lane (y 1000), so it never threatens the barrier and nothing is avoided. rotate(±10°) on a side-view robot looks like the nose pitching up, a hop or jump, not a steering turn. The camera tracks x, so the barrier slides past in under a second.
issues.fix: act3.js S093: lane y = 1000 (same as the barrier) for x < 800 and x > 1300. At x≈850 the blue LED flashes (glow .8), then the robot moves into depth: y 1000→860, s 1.5→1.25, and scaleX 1→.85→1 for a yaw read instead of rotate. Draw PR.barrier in the fg layer only while the robot is behind it. Lock the camera (cam.x fixed at 1000, z .9) so the barrier stays put and the robot visibly goes around it. Remove the rotate() transform.

issues.problem: The emotional hinge still doesn't play. The FG bench is drawn at y 1010-1050, which is inside the 60 px bottom letterbox (and the push to 1.08 crops it further), so there is no visible bench. Noah's hand carries the screwdriver down and out of the bottom of the frame at about 2 s, and for the last 2.6 s he stands empty-handed. The 'one isolated click' has no visible cause.
issues.fix: act3.js S066: bench S.rect(300, 860, 1400, 40) (top at y≈860) and push center y 520→480 so it stays in frame. In P.placeTool(k) the hand target is y≈850. After k≥.99 draw PR.screwdriver(n.handF[0], 855, .5, settle) lying on the bench top and keep it visible to the end. Let the hand rest on the bench next to it for 0.4 s before lifting away (the hesitation).

issues.problem: The shout/panic mouth in rig.js is a D-shape: high flat corners and a deep round bottom. Paired with the slanted brows, it reads as a big laughing grin. In the climax Noah looks gleeful on 'I told you that three weeks ago!' (S086) and 'LEFT SIDE!' (S090), and Eli looks delighted on 'NOAH!' (S083) and 'Okay! What do I do?!' (S089). That inverts the emotion of the most important exchange.
issues.fix: rig.js mouth for 'shout'/'panic': drop the corners below the top. Use an open oval/trapezoid, e.g. S.ellipse(mx, my+.06R, mw*.75, (.13+talk*.08)R), or an arch with the corners at my+.08R and the top apex at my-.04R, plus a flat-ish bottom. For 'panic' add a wavy lower lip or teeth line. Then check S083, S086, S089 and S090 again: they should read as yelling, not laughing.

issues.problem: The story says Eli is oblivious ('didn't notice it at first'). Instead S065 has Eli turned fully to Noah, smiling, as he says 'I'll probably finish it faster', which reads as deliberate gloating. In S067/S068 he stands facing the camera in front of his bench, arm out, idle. He is not working with his back turned while Noah walks out.
issues.fix: act3.js S065: Eli f:-1 (facing his laptop at screen-left), turn .25 so only the profile is visible, expr 'busy', head down (lookY .8). He speaks without turning. S067/S068: Eli A(...{turn: .1 (back three-quarter), pose: P.sitType(c.T), expr:'busy'}) at the bench, so the head and laptop glow face away from Noah's exit.

issues.problem: The geography wide shows the course table with two barriers and the finish flag, but no robot. The robot is supposed to be stuck against the barrier at this moment (S080b just showed it). A viewer wonders where the robot went.
issues.fix: act3.js arenaTable(c): when T is between shotStart('S077') and shotStart('S091'), draw PR.robot at the barrier-3 position on the table (s .35, ledMain flicker, wheel jitter ±2 px) pressed against it.

issues.problem: The phone stands upright beside the desk, the notification floats in mid-air beside it, and Eli's hand never touches it. At 1.6 s it squashes flat by itself (scaleY) and then disappears completely. That reads as magic, not 'he flips it face-down without looking'.
issues.fix: act2.js S054b: lay the phone flat on the desk top (y≈1000) with the screen facing up and put the bubble ON the screen as a lock-screen card, or attach the bubble with a short tail. From 1.2-1.6 s, move Eli's handF to the phone (eyes stay on his work, lookY 1 toward his book). Flip by rotating about the long edge: draw the back face (#1b1820, no glow) at full width after the flip and keep it on screen to the end.

issues.problem: Desk scale is still wrong. In S020 the open book floats at head height and covers his face, so 'rubs his eyes over messy notes' isn't visible. In S044 ('head on his open textbook') the book sits on top of his head and the head is under it.
issues.fix: act1.js bedroomDesk(): raise Eli to y 600 (or h 360→440) and the chair to PR.chair(880, 740, ...) so his head center is about 120 px above the book at y 592 and the forearms rest on the desk. S020: pose mixPose(P.sitWrite, P.sitFacepalm) for the eye-rub. act2.js S044: headAt [1000, 560] with PR.openBook drawn UNDER the head layer (draw the book before the actor), cheek on the right page.

issues.problem: The 'blue backup LED on the robot's left side ignites' is a plain blue rounded rectangle with a dot, floating in front of the blurred arena. There is no chassis, stripe or wheel, so for 0.9 s a viewer sees an abstract shape and doesn't connect it to the robot.
issues.fix: act3.js S091b: draw PR.robot(760, 640, {s: 4.5, ledBackup: on}) cropped so the blue box, part of the red/blue stripes and the rear wheel fill the frame, with the glow on the box. Optionally use the BACKUP SENSOR · LEFT label from S060 (k: appear) so the plant visibly rhymes.

issues.problem: 'A bigger kid simply out-sprints him to the ball' doesn't land. The ball rolls independently (bx = 1000 + 170t). The kid reaches it about 1.9 s in, then runs off screen-right and leaves the ball behind, and Eli jogs toward the abandoned ball. Eli also never 'dribbles neatly' at the start. The kid is barely bigger (h 360 vs 280 reads about the same).
issues.fix: act2.js S045: start with the ball at Eli's feet (bx = ex + 30) for 0-1.0 s with small touches. Then the extra (h 420) sprints in, and once ox >= bx - 40, lock bx = ox + 40 so he takes the ball out of frame. Eli decelerates to P.stand with expr 'unimpressed' when SPEED · STRENGTH ✗ appears.

issues.problem: Still V1's issue: after the whiff Eli lands head-first with his legs up in a diagonal and freezes about 1.6 s. It looks like a stuck frame or a headstand, not 'flat on his back with a thud'. The ball moves only about 100 px.
issues.fix: act1.js S013: end rot at -90° with the torso horizontal at ground y (head and hips at the same y), add a 6-frame bounce and shake(c.t,8) on the land, plus a blink and leg twitch at +0.6 s. Roll the ball 300+ px toward the goal with E.out.

issues.problem: The scoreboard reads 'FINAL 0:60'. No clock shows 0:60, and every earlier round displayed '1:00'.
issues.fix: act3.js fmtClock: n >= 60 ? '1:00' : `0:${String(n).padStart(2,'0')}`.

issues.problem: The shoulder bump is done with the heads: Noah's cap brim pokes into Eli's face and the two heads touch nose-to-cheek (326.0-326.5 s). It reads as head-butting or nuzzling, not a shoulder bump.
issues.fix: act3.js S102: drive the bump with Noah's torso x/lean (shoulder 25 px into Eli) and clamp head separation to ≥1.15× head diameter. Eli's head tilts away (lean -8) while his shoulder takes the hit.

issues.problem: The key clue text is still partly hidden: the grey METAL tag covers 'CON' in 'METAL CAN CONFUSE IT!'.
issues.fix: Move the METAL tag to y-40 (onto the barrier line) or move the red caption 50 px lower. The S087 flashback inherits the fix.

issues.problem: The 'official's hand lifts the trophy' is a disembodied arm held horizontally, its hand about 50 px short of the trophy base. Eli's eyeline change (lookX -1→1 at 0.5 s) is too subtle to read as 'looks past it toward Noah'.
issues.fix: act3.js S097: put bigHand's grip on the trophy stem (x 600, y 900) and lift the trophy 40 px over 0.6 s. Turn Eli's head with turn 0→.35 toward screen-right plus a small body turn, and hold it for 0.8 s.

issues.problem: The obsession objects hover in mid-air in front of Eli's chest: the cube, an upright chessboard like a sign, a standing book, the circuit board. Eli's arms are spread wide, not holding or working them.
issues.fix: act2.js obsession(): rest each object on the desk top (y = desk top − object h/2), lay the chessboard flat (skewY or a top trapezoid), and use a working pose per object with the hands at the object (cube twist, chess reach, page turn, soldering lean).

issues.problem: Eli's stool is about 150 px from the end of the keyboard, so he can't be 'playing the first bars'. His arms reach into empty air. In S108 the seated pose with the legs crossed horizontally and the arms spread reads as a meditation pose, and there is no piano in frame.
issues.fix: act3.js S106: put Eli's stool flush with the keyboard's right end (x = piano right edge − 40) and put his hands on the keys. S108: same P.sit as S107 with the keyboard edge in the bottom FG and his hands on it.

issues.problem: The piano and keyboard hands are still flat palms facing the camera with the fingers pointing up, hovering over the keys, so they don't look like playing or typing.
issues.fix: props/common bigHand: add a {palmDown:true} variant (knuckle bumps toward the camera, fingertips toward the keys, fingers foreshortened) for the TOP inserts.

issues.problem: S051: Eli smiles at the camera instead of looking up at the student, and the cube is already on the desk (no slap). S069: no glance at the empty stool. S010: the talking mouth curves up, so the 'unamused' teacher looks pleased. S089: the 'timer large in the foreground' is a small chip.
issues.fix: S051 Eli lookX 1, lookY -.6, cube drops from the student's hand at 0.2 s with a thud. S069: lookX 1 for 0.6-1.4 s toward the stool, then back. Talking mouth for 'unimpressed': flat top edge. S089: finalTimer(c, 1450, 880) with size 140.

issues.problem: The dashed ROUTE_OK passes the bottom tip of barrier 2, so in the 'easy' rounds the robot drives across that barrier in the overhead, and again in S094. This muddies the 'metal barrier = danger' idea.
issues.fix: act3.js ROUTE_OK/ROUTE_RECOVER: change [1420, 500] to [1420, 560] (or move barrier 2 up 60 px) so the route clears it by ≥40 px.
